full_name: Leigh Ann Wheeler | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2025–2026 History Joy Foundation Fellow Binghamton University
bio: Leigh Ann Wheeler is a professor of history at Binghamton University; an author of books on women, civil liberties, and social movements; a past editor of the Journal of Women’s History; and a two-time National Endowment for the Humanities fellow. At Radcliffe, she will complete her biography, currently under contract with Oxford University Press, of the beloved memoirist and civil rights activist Anne Moody.
